svg.aria-label: The indexing pipeline from Gutenberg text through six stages, build-db with leak tests and promote, to the app and chat, as rebuilt to read the text once
svg.text: FROM TEXT TO A GRAPH YOU CAN ASK · THE TEXT IS READ ONCE
index run --book <id> [--glean] [--budget-tokens N | --budget-usd N] [--promote] · an estimate before the first call; a budget refuses (exit 3) before it
a bar per stage · index watch / status / cancel from another terminal · Ctrl+C finishes the call in flight and prints the command that continues (--from-run)
evidence checked against the text · enums checked by code · the skill cached for an hour, the chunk for five minutes · 8 calls in flight · run.log
Hound on the full schema (promoted): 1,643 nodes · 4,992 edges · 0 of 6,635 elements without a story time.
That run read the text ~15 times: 2,785 calls, 16.2M tokens in. The one-read pipeline on the same book: 248 calls, 1.15M in, 10 minutes —
not promoted: entity recall on ch. 1–3 fell under the floor without --glean.
Musketeers and Treasure Island are on the earlier shape.
